items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Joe Glaser's relationship with Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington, stating 'we knew it in the -- we knew how close' referring to the Glaser-Armstrong bond, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Glaser himself.

ctx.x: And then Duke used to say, Joe Glaser doesn't care as much about me as he does Louis. He gives Louis better dates.

Well, I don't think Joe Glaser cared as much about his own mother as he did Louis, if you really want to know the truth, because -- did you ever know that story of how Glaser got to be Louis' manager?

Barney said something about them both coming -- on a boat coming back from England, Louis' manager at that time wanted to teach Louis a lesson and said, I'm going to sell your contract, and Joe was there or something. Was that what happened?
